> TFT screen following the guide to build something of my own. so this is what i came up with. the led matrix plus 4 different buttons. when each buttons is clicked there are about ten different things that can be displayed. once a button is clicked it choses one random thing from the list of things that particular button can display and displays it

### 2026-10-29: So this journal might look very unrelated to my entry 1. I was a bit confused on how the guide was meant to work. I went ahead to work with Ki Cad even though my idea did not require a PCB design. So

**2h**

So this journal might look very unrelated to my entry 1. I was a bit confused on how the guide was meant to work. I went ahead to work with Ki Cad even though my idea did not require a PCB design. So after i spoke to someone from half-life channel I was able to figure myself out. For this session i worked on Drawing diagrams of the OLED matrix display and figuring out how they work alongside an Arduino uno with limited pins. The row and column led and pins were really confusing but thinking about matrix made it so much clearer. I also had to watch several YouTube shorts and some very short tutorial to figure out how the led matrix displayed what it is meant to display. Here's a link of one of the short videos that got me on track
https://youtu.be/G4lIo-MRSiY?si=6yLjz45UZn18TJv0

### 2026-10-29: So basically for this session I designed or rather I traced all the symbols and shapes I intend to display on my Led Matrix. And I also tagged all the led that would be brightened during display using

**1.8h**

So basically for this session I designed or rather I traced all the symbols and shapes I intend to display on my Led Matrix. And I also tagged all the led that would be brightened during display using the matrix system. This was a simple but time taking process drawing multiple 8*8 led matrix to map out each symbol was very tasking. At first i was using a ruler to get straight lines but later on I got tired and started with free-hand sketch.
Y=yes, N=no,
Also shapes Triangle, square, I tried a circle but it ended up more of a Rhombus, and also a Plus shape. And lastly a few numbers too
